		tooltip = DA_ME_path_unlocked_tt
		has_country_flag = DA_unlocked.mega_engineering

# Transcendence research: true while a playable path is still locked.
# Mana Core is in development; add it here when it is playable.
DA_has_transcendent_path_to_unlock = {
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_has_transcendent_path_to_unlock_tt
		OR = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_unlocked.mega_engineering }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_unlocked.genetic_engineering }
		}
	}
}

		DA_ME_has_ambient_mana_collector = yes
		DA_ME_has_Anti_Magic_Barrier = yes

	}
}
DA_ME_province_is_building = {
	OR = {
		has_province_flag = DA_ME_building.Hyper_Conductive_Mana_Reserve
		has_province_flag = DA_ME_building.ambient_mana_collector
		has_province_flag = DA_ME_building.Anti_Magic_Barrier
		has_province_flag = DA_ME_building.Floating_Fortress
		has_province_flag = DA_ME_building.Core_Driller
		has_province_flag = DA_ME_building.Mega_Hold
		has_province_flag = DA_ME_building.Megalopolis
		has_province_flag = DA_ME_building.Mega_Port
	}
}
DA_ME_province_has_any = {
	OR = {
		DA_ME_province_has_structure = yes
		DA_ME_province_is_building = yes
	}
}

DA_ME_site_ok = {
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_ME_secure_city_tt
		is_city = yes
		controlled_by = owner
		has_siege = no
	}
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_ME_idle_province_tt
		NOT = { has_construction = any }
		NOT = { has_colonist = yes }
		NOT = { has_missionary = yes }
	}
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_ME_building_space_tt
		num_free_building_slots = 1
	}
}
DA_ME_one_per_province = {
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_ME_one_per_province_tt
		NOT = { DA_ME_province_has_any = yes }
	}
}

# Mirrors the engine's additive global/local build-cost modifiers and 10% floor (same as DA_can_afford_special_fort).
DA_ME_can_afford = {
	variable_arithmetic_trigger = {
		custom_tooltip = DA_ME_can_afford_tt
		export_to_variable = { which = DA_me_global_cost value = modifier:build_cost who = owner }
		export_to_variable = { which = DA_me_cost value = modifier:local_build_cost }
		export_to_variable = { which = DA_me_gold value = treasury who = owner }
		change_variable = { which = DA_me_cost which = DA_me_global_cost }
		change_variable = { which = DA_me_cost value = 1 }
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_me_cost value = $cost$ }
		OR = {
			AND = {
				check_variable = { which = DA_me_cost value = $minimum$ }
				check_variable = { which = DA_me_gold which = DA_me_cost }
			}
			AND = {
				NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_me_cost value = $minimum$ } }
				check_variable = { which = DA_me_gold value = $minimum$ }
			}
		}
	}
}

		owner = {
			NOT = {

					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

######## Megalopolis and secret societies (province scope) ########

DA_ME_society_can_settle_Hammers_of_Halanna = {
	NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_ME_society.Hammers_of_Halanna }
	owner = {
		has_country_flag = DA_SC_unlocked.Hammers_of_Halanna
		DA_SS_has_rank = { society = hammers rank = 4 }
	}
}
DA_ME_society_can_settle_Pioneer_Society = {
	NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_ME_society.Pioneer_Society }
	owner = {
		has_country_flag = DA_SC_unlocked.Pioneer_Society
		DA_SS_has_rank = { society = pioneer rank = 4 }
	}
}
DA_ME_society_can_settle_Hermetic_order = {
	NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_ME_society.Hermetic_order }
	owner = {
		has_country_flag = DA_SC_unlocked.Hermetic_order
		DA_SS_has_rank = { society = hermetic rank = 4 }
	}
}
DA_ME_society_can_settle_Seekers_of_Perfection = {
	NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_ME_society.Seekers_of_Perfection }
	owner = {
		has_country_flag = DA_SC_unlocked.Seekers_of_Perfection
		DA_SS_has_rank = { society = seekers rank = 4 }
	}
}
DA_ME_society_can_settle_Brotherhood_of_the_Skull = {
	NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_ME_society.Brotherhood_of_the_Skull }
	owner = {
		has_country_flag = DA_SC_unlocked.Brotherhood_of_the_Skull
		DA_SS_has_rank = { society = concord rank = 4 }
	}
}
DA_ME_megalopolis_can_invite = {
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_ME_megalopolis_can_invite_tt
		OR = {
			DA_ME_society_can_settle_Hammers_of_Halanna = yes
			DA_ME_society_can_settle_Pioneer_Society = yes
			DA_ME_society_can_settle_Hermetic_order = yes
			DA_ME_society_can_settle_Seekers_of_Perfection = yes
			DA_ME_society_can_settle_Brotherhood_of_the_Skull = yes
		}
	}
}
